questions.question_text: A small nonprofit wants to add a new employee to Microsoft Entra ID. Which approach is the most straightforward for creating the user account?

options.label: A
options.text: Using the Azure portal's "Create user" blade

options.label: B
options.text: Running the Azure CLI command `az ad user create`

options.label: C
options.text: Executing a PowerShell script with New-AzureADUser

options.label: D
options.text: Calling the Microsoft Graph API endpoint /users

questions.explanation: According to Microsoft documentation, the Azure portal provides a guided UI for creating users, which is the typical method for small organizations; CLI, PowerShell, and Graph are also possible but require additional setup.

questions.question_text: An administrator needs to add a custom attribute named 'Department' to user profiles and then use it to create a dynamic group. Which Azure feature should they use?

options.label: A
options.text: Azure portal's custom user attributes

options.label: B
options.text: Azure AD Connect synchronization settings

options.label: C
options.text: Azure AD B2C user attributes

options.label: D
options.text: Azure Policy definitions

questions.explanation: The portal allows administrators to add custom attributes to user objects, which can then be referenced in dynamic group rules; other options do not provide this capability.

questions.question_text: A company wants to assign a Microsoft 365 E3 license to a group of 50 users in Microsoft Entra ID. Which step must be performed?

options.label: A
options.text: Assign the license directly to each user individually

options.label: B
options.text: Create a security group and assign the license to the group

options.label: C
options.text: Enable Azure AD Premium P1 before licensing

options.label: D
options.text: Sync the users from an on-premises Active Directory

questions.explanation: Microsoft documentation states that licenses can be assigned to groups, allowing all members to receive the license without individual assignments; this is the recommended approach for efficiency.

questions.question_text: A partner organization needs temporary access to an Azure resource for a project lasting two weeks. What is the appropriate way to provide this access in Microsoft Entra ID?

options.label: A
options.text: Add the partner as a member of the resource's Azure AD tenant

options.label: B
options.text: Invite the partner as a guest user with appropriate role assignment

options.label: C
options.text: Create a new service principal for the partner

options.label: D
options.text: Disable the partner's existing account and reactivate later

questions.explanation: The Azure AD B2B collaboration feature lets you invite external users as guests and assign them the needed roles; this provides limited-time access without creating a new tenant or altering the partner's account.

questions.question_text: An organization wants to enable self-service password reset for a specific group of employees while keeping other users on the default password reset policy. Which configuration should the administrator use?

options.label: A
options.text: Turn on SSPR tenant-wide and rely on Azure AD's built-in filtering

options.label: B
options.text: Configure SSPR per individual user based on their department

options.label: C
options.text: Enable SSPR and specify authentication methods for the target group only

options.label: D
options.text: Use Azure AD Connect to sync password reset settings from on-premises

questions.explanation: The SSPR settings can be applied to selected groups by enabling the feature and then choosing the authentication methods for those groups; this allows targeted deployment without affecting other users.
